# Task t-1 files
Edit files, then call `submit`; it answers per file. Formats and limits: ../AGENTS.md.
Read-only (edits undone): README.md, task.yaml, state.yaml (step, branch setup, children).
You write: proofs/<slug>/[[CH:, children/<slug>/]] and your draft, the last section `## draft-<step>` of handovers.md.
Handed handovers: handovers.md, one `## NNNN from to to` section each, oldest first. User notes: notes.md, one section per note.
